name: Deakin Student Support Scholarship
summary: Up to $10,000 a year for domestic Deakin students facing financial, regional, disability, refugee or other hardship.
key: $2,500 to $10,000 a year, or a $1,000 one-off payment.
who: Domestic student enrolling in a CSP associate, bachelor or honours degree, or a postgraduate coursework degree.
Full-time in Trimester/Semester 1 2027 unless circumstances prevent it.
Experiencing hardship such as financial hardship, regional location, disability, Indigenous background or refugee arrival.
how: Apply through Deakin's Scholarship Application Portal and upload evidence.
catches: Opened 14 September 2026. Bachelor round one closes 5pm Wednesday 16 December 2026, re-offer round 20 January 2027.
Associate, honours and postgraduate applications close 5pm Wednesday 3 February 2027.
